keyPoints.en: Motives: economy (spice trade), religion, power and glory.
keyPoints.bm: Motif: ekonomi (perdagangan rempah), agama, kuasa dan kegemilangan.

keyPoints.en: 1641: the Dutch, helped by Johor, took Melaka from Portugal.
keyPoints.bm: 1641: Belanda, dibantu Johor, merampas Melaka daripada Portugis.

keyPoints.en: 1786: Francis Light occupied Penang; Sultan Abdullah of Kedah hoped for protection from Siam.
keyPoints.bm: 1786: Francis Light menduduki Pulau Pinang; Sultan Abdullah Kedah mengharapkan perlindungan daripada Siam.

keyPoints.en: 1819: Stamford Raffles opened Singapore as a free port on the India–China route.
keyPoints.bm: 1819: Stamford Raffles membuka Singapura sebagai pelabuhan bebas di laluan India–China.

keyPoints.en: 17 March 1824: Britain and the Netherlands divided the Malay world.
keyPoints.bm: 17 Mac 1824: Britain dan Belanda membahagikan Alam Melayu.

keyPoints.en: Britain got Melaka and areas north of Singapore; the Dutch got Bencoolen and areas south of Singapore.
keyPoints.bm: Britain mendapat Melaka dan kawasan utara Singapura; Belanda mendapat Bangkahulu dan kawasan selatan Singapura.

keyPoints.en: Johor-Riau was split; local rulers were not consulted.
keyPoints.bm: Johor-Riau terpecah; pemerintah tempatan tidak dirunding.

tip.en: Draw a simple map with a line through Singapore to remember the 1824 division.
tip.bm: Lukis peta ringkas dengan garis melalui Singapura untuk mengingat pembahagian 1824.
